bioParagraphs: I am a Senior Full-Stack Engineer and Freelance SaaS Architect with over 5+ years of experience transforming complex technical requirements into scalable, ultra-fast web products.

My core mastery spans the MERN and PERN ecosystems—leveraging PostgreSQL and MongoDB for tailored database performance, Redis for microsecond-level caching, and Docker with automated GitHub Actions CI/CD for flawless VPS deployments.
Lately, I integrate cutting-edge LLM agents and AI workflows (such as Claude Code & OpenAI APIs) directly into production systems, giving businesses an unmatched competitive edge.

faqs.question: What is your typical project timeline?
faqs.answer: Small AI integrations and DevOps setups take 3-7 days. Full-stack MVP web apps or SaaS platforms typically take 3-6 weeks depending on feature scope.

faqs.question: Can I easily update the portfolio content myself?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every piece of text, project, skill, service, and contact detail is driven entirely from the data/portfolio.json file. You don't need to touch React code to make updates.

faqs.question: How do you handle hosting & VPS deployment?
faqs.answer: I configure production-ready Docker containers and setup reverse proxy servers (Nginx) on VPS providers like DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or AWS EC2, automated via GitHub Actions.

faqs.question: Are you available for contract or full-time roles?
faqs.answer: Yes, I am currently taking on high-impact freelance projects, advisory roles, and selective contract opportunities.
